name: Terminology change verification
on:
  push:
    branches: ['maintenance/terminology-review-20260928']
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  verify-transfer:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 3bb4b8c4b2e60ca90f41b416b047a0bf7b5faea2
      - uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: temurin
      - name: Reconstruct and verify the reviewed source tree
        env:
          BUNDLE: ''
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 3bb4b8c4b2e60ca90f41b416b047a0bf7b5faea2
          python - <<'PY'
          import base64,gzip,hashlib,json,os
          from pathlib import Path
          raw=gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(os.environ['BUNDLE']))
          assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='d31effbfd725404baa6dce225331097aa3dd11fceb90a6d9f01464ee018a517f'
          bundle=json.loads(raw)
          for name,content in bundle['files'].items():
              assert name.startswith('taxonomy-build/src/test/java/com/taxonomy/build/ScenarioAcceptanceNaming')
              Path(name).write_text(content)
          exec(compile(bundle['script'],'reviewed-neutral-terminology','exec'))
          PY
          test "$(git write-tree)" = 9d955bfc376c2cf04a980443d8b7affe3f581d5d
          git diff --cached --check
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/terminology-classes" "$RUNNER_TEMP/terminology-evidence"
          find taxonomy-tooling/src/main/java -name '*.java' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/tooling-sources.txt"
          javac --release 21 -Xlint:all -Werror -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/terminology-classes" @"$RUNNER_TEMP/tooling-sources.txt"
          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/NamingProbe.java" <<'JAVA'
          package com.taxonomy.build;
          import java.nio.file.Path;
          public final class NamingProbe {
            public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
              ScenarioAcceptanceNamingContract.verifyNames(Path.of(args[0]));
              ScenarioAcceptanceNamingContract.verifyWiring(Path.of(args[0]));
              System.out.println("Scenario naming and selection contract passed");
            }
          }
          JAVA
          javac --release 21 -Xlint:all -Werror -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/terminology-classes" taxonomy-build/src/test/java/com/taxonomy/build/ScenarioAcceptanceNamingContract.java "$RUNNER_TEMP/NamingProbe.java"
          java -cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/terminology-classes" com.taxonomy.build.NamingProbe "$PWD" | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/terminology-evidence/naming.txt"
          node --test .github/scripts/architecture-workbench-fit.test.mjs | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/terminology-evidence/node.txt"
          test -z "$(git ls-remote --heads origin refs/heads/transfer/neutral-terminology-verified-20260928)"
          git -c user.name=ChatGPT -c user.email=chatgpt@users.noreply.github.com commit -m 'refactor: use neutral product and scenario terminology'
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})" = 9d955bfc376c2cf04a980443d8b7affe3f581d5d
          git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} > "$RUNNER_TEMP/terminology-evidence/source.txt"
          git show --stat HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/terminology-evidence/change.txt"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/transfer/neutral-terminology-verified-20260928
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        if: always()
        with:
          name: terminology-change-verification
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/terminology-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
